subject.title: fix(agents): treat codex exec_command as exec-like

question: Should this PR require live Codex app-server proof before merge, or is sibling Codex source plus focused OpenClaw event-path tests enough for this warning-policy fix?
rationale: The code direction is well supported, but the contributor did not prove the changed behavior in a live Codex app-server turn and current OpenClaw also has a producer-path projection that maps commandExecution items to `bash`.

options.title: Require live app-server proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a recording that shows read-only `exec_command` warning suppression and mutating warning visibility after the patch.

options.title: Accept source-contract proof
options.body: Treat the Codex source contract and OpenClaw focused tests as sufficient despite the missing live producer-path evidence.

options.title: Pause until producer evidence exists
options.body: Leave the PR open or close later if no evidence shows raw `exec_command` reaches this warning path on current OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Require live app-server proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a recording that shows read-only `exec_command` warning suppression and mutating warning visibility after the patch.
